question: Within 1700 meters from Johnny's Bagel & Deli, Bethlehem, PA, how many golf courses are present with elevation lower than 500 m?
sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.381857 40.620477)',4326)::geography, 1700)
    AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 500;

[1].display_name: Garland Fountains Golf Course, Lewiston, MI

[3].display_name: Johnny's Bagel & Deli, Bethlehem, PA
